svg.title: billing_db physical schema
svg.desc: ER diagram of ten billing tables with primary and foreign keys, CHECK constraints, partial unique indexes and the append-only archive.

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: billing_db: ten tables from twelve migrations
Catalog is seeded by 000012; payments.subscription_id is deliberately not a foreign key (ADR-005 audit trail).
no FK to subscriptions: ADR-005 audit trail
PK (account_id, key) · expires_at default now()+7 d
UNIQUE event_id · index WHERE sent_at IS NULL
APPEND-ONLY: trigger raises on UPDATE / DELETE
CHK = DB CHECK duplicates the domain guard · PTU = partial unique index · FKs RESTRICT unless stated · scheduled_target_tariff_plan also references tariff_plans (not drawn)
